interface.port_types: Unsigned packed logic vectors; no other ports

semantics.function: sel 0 through 5 selects the corresponding data0 through data5; sel 6 or 7 produces zero
semantics.timing: Pure combinational logic; out follows current inputs after combinational settling, with no clock-cycle latency
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization requirement

numeric.behavior: Bit-exact forwarding of four-bit data or 4'b0000; no arithmetic, rounding, truncation, saturation, or overflow

verification.oracle: Independent testbench array indexed by integer selector for 0 through 5, otherwise four-bit zero
verification.coverage: For all eight selectors, vary each of the six inputs independently over all sixteen four-bit values against nonuniform baseline inputs; additionally check all-zero and all-one inputs
verification.timing: Check after a finite combinational settling delay following each input change
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; matching vvp; finite external timeouts
verification.review: Check exact interface, complete combinational assignment, sized case labels, no state or simulation constructs in DUT

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X/Z selector bits is unspecified by the original problem; no verification requirement is imposed for those values.
